text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! I'm all warmed up and
ready t'go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm keen as a bean! That time off gave
me all the
rest I needed! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I slept like a log, got some knitt'n done,
and did that self-care thingy all the city
girls do! Oh, I
called home and got a
boost from my family too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So! What're we gonna start with? Gimme
all
you've got! I'm rar'n t'go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After some fruitful time off, Yukino Bijin
is all
fired up and ready to train!
